name: Linear (marketing site + product chrome as shown on it)
licence: Proprietary. No public token files or component library. Brand guidelines (linear.app/brand) forbid altering marks or implying affiliation. Values here are measured from the live marketing CSS and DOM (study structure and values only); the app itself was not accessible (no login).
bestFor: developer and product-team tools, issue trackers, AI agent products
dark-first B2B SaaS marketing where the product UI is the hero
dense list, board and command-driven app UI
brands whose accent colour should be rare and quiet
avoidFor: consumer, lifestyle or playful brands that need warmth and colour
editorial or content-heavy sites (small grey 13-15px text dominates)
low-vision-first audiences unless tertiary/quaternary text is raised (quaternary text is 3.45:1 on the dark canvas)

families: Inter Variable (body and headings; font-feature-settings "cv01","ss03"; font-variation-settings "opsz" auto)
Berkeley Mono (code, issue ids, 182 text nodes on the home page)
Tiempos Headline (serif display, declared as --font-serif-display; where it is used was not observed)

scale.role: hero h1 (/ai) and pricing section h2 (1440)

typography.notes: Signature is weight 510 (variable font; named weights light 300 / normal 400 / medium 510 / semibold 590 / bold 680). Tracking is a function of size: -0.011em to -0.013em at 14-15px, -0.012em at 17-24px, -0.022em at 32px and up. Line-height tightens as size rises (1.6 at 17px, 1.4 at 17px title, 1.33 at 20-24, 1.125 at 32, 1.1 at 40, 1.0 at 48+). Each text token is a single shorthand var (--text-regular: size/line-height family) with sibling -letter-spacing var. Published token ramp from stylesheet: tiny .625rem, micro .75rem, mini .8125rem, small .875rem, regular .9375rem, large 1.0625rem; titles 1.0625, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3rem. Measured 2026-10-08 at 1440 and 390 on linear.app, /pricing, /docs, /ai.

neutrals.dark.bg.canvas: #08090a (--color-bg-primary, measured body bg rgb(8,9,10)); marketing alt #010102
neutrals.dark.translucent.fills: rgba(255,255,255,0.02) / 0.05 / 0.08 (measured: most common bg after canvas is rgba(255,255,255,0.08) x36)
neutrals.light.bg: #fff, level1 #f8f8f8, level2 #f4f4f4, level3 #f0f0f0; secondary #f9f8f9, tertiary #f4f2f4, quaternary #eeedef

accents.note: Two values exist per token in the stylesheet (e.g. #7170ff vs #8989f0); which belongs to dark vs light/legacy theme was not verified for every token.

color.darkMode: Marketing site is dark-only: body stays rgb(8,9,10) with prefers-color-scheme light and dark (measured 2026-10-08). The app has light, dark and custom themes: public write-up says each theme went from 98 variables to 3 inputs (base colour, accent colour, contrast) generated in LCH; surfaces step in lightness, separated by 1px hairlines (rgba(255,255,255,0.05-0.08) inset rings) rather than by shadow. March 2026 refresh moved default greys from cool blue-leaning to warmer, less saturated; the stylesheet measured today still carries the cool values (#08090a).
color.contrastNotes: Computed WCAG on #08090a: #f7f8f8 18.73:1, #d0d6e0 13.64:1, #8a8f98 6.13:1, #62666d 3.45:1 (below AA, used for placeholders and section labels), #7170ff accent 5.18:1. White on #5e6ad2 4.7:1. Light theme: #6f6e77 on white 5.03:1, #86848d 3.68:1 (below AA).

spacing.base: 8px (--spacing: 8px token) with 4px sub-steps (inferred from 7px/4px/6px paddings measured on sidebar rows). Notes: Tokens seen: --page-inset 32px, --grid-gap 32px, --page-padding-inline 24px, --page-padding-block 64px, --page-padding-y 48px, --page-max-width 1024px (prose pages), --header-height 64/72px (measured nav 72px at 1440). Hero content left edge x=80 at 1440 (container about 1280); product frame 1320x720 at x=60. Scale values other than 8/32/64 are inferred from measured paddings.

radius.rule: Tokens --radius-4/6/8/12/16/24/32, --radius-circle 50%, --radius-rounded 9999px. Marketing nav buttons and CTAs are full pills (9999px; 72 elements), app rows and buttons are 8px, small chips 4-6px, product frame and big cards 12px (frame is 12px with a top-radius 12/12/0/0 variant), 16px for large media. Measured histogram: 9999px x72, 8px x29, 50% x28, 4px x22, 12px x19, 9px x18, 6px x10.

shadows: measured inner glow: inset rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 0 0 12px (x7); inset rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 0 0 0 0.5px (x5); inset rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 0 0 0 1px (x4)
depth.borders: Hairlines carry elevation in dark: 1px (and 0.5px via --border-hairline) at rgba(255,255,255,0.05-0.15) or solid #23252a; product frame border 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Dividers are numerous but low contrast; March 2026 refresh reduced divider count and rounded their ends.
depth.blur: Sticky header: --header-blur 20px over --header-bg #0b0b0bcc (80% opaque) in dark, #fffc in light; 1px bottom border rgba(255,255,255,0.08).

easings: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94) ease-out-quad (default for hover color/background, 187 elements)
full named library as vars: ease-in/out/in-out x quad, cubic, quart, quint, expo, circ
motion.notes: Interaction feedback is fast (100ms colour on nav links, 160ms border/filter/transform on buttons, --duration .18s token). Only large illustrative transforms use 700ms. Measured transition property lists are explicit (color, background, border, filter, transform), never `all`, except body default. prefers-reduced-motion handling not verified.

list: CTA pill (translucent white fill + 1px inset ring)
agent chat panel with model chip
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Not publicly specified. Observed only: nav buttons transition color+background in 100ms; CTA transitions border in 160ms; selected sidebar row bg rgba(255,255,255,0.04); focus ring rgba(94,106,210,0.4) 3px. Hover/active/disabled for each component unknown.

tokenArchitecture: Three layers, all CSS custom properties: (1) generator inputs (base, accent, contrast; LCH) producing (2) ordinal semantic roles: --color-bg-primary..quinary, --color-text-primary..quaternary, --color-border-primary..tertiary, --color-line-primary..quaternary, --color-accent/-hover/-tint, --color-brand-bg, then (3) page and component tokens (--header-bg/-height/-blur, --text-regular shorthand, --title-1..7, --shadow-low/medium/high, --radius-N, --ease-*). Roles are named by rank, not by function (primary..quinary), and each text style is a size/line-height/family shorthand with a sibling letter-spacing var. Fonts and weights are tokens (--font-weight-medium 510).
distinctiveness: Near-black #08090a canvas with luminous 1px hairlines instead of shadows; Inter at the odd weight 510 with -0.022em tracking at display sizes and cv01/ss03 alternates; grey text hierarchy of four steps with the brightest white reserved for headings; one muted indigo accent that appears on almost nothing; pill-shaped nav and CTAs against 8px-radius product UI; the hero is a live, readable product frame (1320x720, 12px radius) not an illustration. Generic dark SaaS sites copy the black but not the hairline system, the 510 weight or the restraint.
weaknesses: no public token files, component library or state specs; everything here is reverse-measured
quaternary text (#62666d, 3.45:1) and light quaternary (#86848d, 3.68:1) fail AA but carry labels and placeholders
tiny 10-13px grey text throughout; poor for casual readers and small screens
marketing is dark-only; no light variant to learn from
ordinal role names (primary..quinary) tell you rank, not purpose, so misuse is easy
mobile hero frame collapses to a tall text stack (document 5876px at 390 vs 9960px at 1440)
takeaways: Generate every theme from three inputs (base, accent, contrast) in a perceptual space; never hand-author per-theme variable lists
Type tokens bundle size + line-height + tracking, and tracking is a function of size (about -0.011em small, -0.022em display)
Use a single odd variable weight (510) as the brand weight; named weights 400/510/590/680 form the whole ladder
Carry elevation in dark with lightness steps plus 1px translucent hairlines, not shadows; reserve real shadows for popovers and dialogs
Four-step text hierarchy (primary/secondary/tertiary/quaternary) with explicit contrast floors; ban quaternary for anything the user must read
Explicit transition property lists with 100-160ms for interaction and long durations only for decorative motion
Pill grammar for marketing chrome, 8px radius for dense app rows: two radius grammars with a clear boundary
Make the hero a real, readable product surface; show a workflow, not a mock-up of decoration
